sounds.name: engine_loop
sounds.prompt: Continuous low sci-fi spacecraft thruster drone, smooth steady hum with a subtle metallic harmonic shimmer on top, constant volume, no rhythm, no impacts, no melody, clean seamless loop.

sounds.name: wind_loop
sounds.prompt: Steady rushing air inside a narrow tunnel, smooth airy high-speed whoosh bed, constant intensity, no gusts, no impacts, no music, clean seamless loop.

sounds.name: music_loop
sounds.prompt: Driving dark synthwave loop at 130 BPM, pulsing analog bassline, tight arpeggiated neon synth, punchy electronic drums, retro cyberpunk racing energy, instrumental, no vocals, seamless loop.

sounds.name: coin
sounds.prompt: Bright metallic coin pickup, short crystalline ping with a quick sparkling tail, clean arcade video game collectible, no reverb wash.

sounds.name: mission_complete
sounds.prompt: Rewarding achievement unlocked chime, warm bright bell arpeggio rising to a confident resolve, positive confirmation, polished game UI.

sounds.name: level_up
sounds.prompt: Triumphant sci-fi level complete sting, bright ascending synth riser landing on a wide satisfying chord, energetic arcade fanfare.

sounds.name: near_miss
sounds.prompt: Fast doppler whoosh passing extremely close, sharp air displacement swish sweeping past the listener from front to back, dry and brief.

sounds.name: impact
sounds.prompt: Heavy metallic crash, spacecraft hull slamming hard into a steel barrier, deep punchy thud layered with a bright metal clang and a short ringing tail.

sounds.name: debris
sounds.prompt: Shattered metal and glass debris scattering outward, sharp shards clattering and tumbling away, dense fragmented rubble, dry.

sounds.name: low_life
sounds.prompt: Tense warning alarm pulse, low ominous electronic beep with a dark reverb tail, critical danger alert in a spacecraft cockpit.

sounds.name: game_over
sounds.prompt: Sci-fi power-down failure, descending detuned synth collapsing into a dark bass drop, machine losing power and shutting off, bleak.

sounds.name: boost_start
sounds.prompt: Turbine spooling up into a powerful accelerating whoosh, rising pitch sci-fi speed boost, building pressure and forward thrust.

sounds.name: boost_end
sounds.prompt: Powering down from extreme speed, descending airy whoosh settling into calm, pressure releasing, smooth deceleration.

sounds.name: portal
sounds.prompt: Passing through a shimmering energy portal, glassy warp shimmer sweeping past with a soft deep bass swell underneath, magical sci-fi transition.

sounds.name: ui_click
sounds.prompt: Short clean digital interface blip, soft holographic menu tap, crisp and dry, no reverb.

sounds.name: ui_buy
sounds.prompt: Satisfying purchase confirmation, digital cash register chime with a bright sparkle flourish, rewarding shop transaction.
